text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was the same last year, but it gets 
terribly hot by the seaside, doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
Make sure you take good care of yourself, 
okay?
Be sure to take care of yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I can't afford to collapse 
here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Once summer training camp is over, the 
Sprinters Stakes will be right around the 
corner, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike last year, neither of them is 
overly tense, seemingly relaxed in a good 
way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Please give me lots of training this year 
too! I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our second summer training camp 
with Nishino Flower began.
